headlines.title: Teen Dies From Irregular Heartbeat After Taking GLP-1: Report
headlines.description: UK media are reporting that a 19-year-old American college student died in her dorm room last year after taking a GLP-1 weight loss drug. Court papers show that Josephine Nassar died from a fatal irregular heartbeat triggered in part by the GLP-1 and a heart condition that she apparently had been born with.

headlines.title: Young Girl Undergoes 14 Months of Chemo for Two Brain Tumors
headlines.description: Maddie Fries was just 10 months old when her family received a diagnosis of neurofibromatosis type 1, a genetic condition that causes tumors to grow on nerve tissue throughout the body. Then, doctors found two tumors growing along the nerves connecting her eyes to her brain. Maddie began chemotherapy when she was three that went on for fourteen months. Now five, Maddie is back to her normal routine and her tumors are stable. WKYC's Monica Robins reports.

headlines.title: How To Treat Common Aches and Pains at Home
headlines.description: Medications are not one size fits all, so NBC News medical contributor Dr. Akshay Syal joins TODAY to break down the best medicines for every ailment. He explains when to use acetaminophen versus ibuprofen, when to throw away old medicines, and more.

headlines.title: Exclusive: US News and World Report Rates GLP-1 Web Providers
headlines.description: As millions turn to online telehealth platforms to get weight loss drugs, U.S. News and World Report is launching its first-ever official evaluation and ratings of GLP-1 online providers. Gretel Schueller, managing editor of health, joins TODAY to share an exclusive look at the list and discuss best practices to find safe medication online.
